Mod.Name: Ticket Booth
Mod.Author: NyanDoggo
Mod.Description: Become a licensed lottery retailer. After the first week the Lottery Representative offers you a retailer licence for 300 credits; take it and you get the Lottery Board's phone line, which ships lottery tickets and scratchers in bulk every 5 days. Lower-level citizens come to buy them from you, and come back to cash their wins at your counter, paid from your till. Some of those winning tickets are forged: check the stamp, the edition, the numbers and the symbols before you pay. Refusing an honest winner costs reputation. Optional meme mode lets customers hit the jackpot.
